summary: The root نسك (nsk) primarily means to devote oneself to religious exercises or devotion. It describes someone who becomes a devout worshipper, engaging in acts of piety.
lane: 5 تَنَسَّكَ ذ He devoted himself to religious exercises; applied himself to devotion; (S, Msb, K:) as also (S, K) and : (K:) or the last, he became a نَاسِك . (S.)
